geeklist.title: No Ship Games Auction Ontario Canada - Help me pay for my cats surgery & Merry Christmas - Ending @ 8 PM EST on Thurs Dec 18, 2025
geeklist.description:
This auction is for my sweet baby cat Freddie Purrcury who has some issues with her teeth and needs surgery. I'm currently not working and applying for disability, so money is very tight for me. Please take a look at my [url=https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-fred-freddie-purrcury-get-her-dental-surgery]GoFundMe[/url] and consider a donation if you would like to help us. [url=https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-fred-freddie-purrcury-get-her-dental-surgery]GoFundMe -- Help Freddie Purrcury get her dental surgery[/url] Money raised in this auction will go towards Freddie's surgery and help with Christmas for my family.
[imageid=9271382 medium]
[b]Check out my auction for some deals![/b]
[b][color=#1ad51d]BIDDING AND PAYMENT[/color][/b] -all bids are in Canadian dollars -a minimum starting bid is listed with each item -all bids must be in minimum $1.00 increments -bid by leaving a comment with the amount under the item you are bidding on -payment is through PayPal, e-transfer or in cash [color=#ff0000]-IMPORTANT: If you bid and do NOT check your GeekMail regularly, please leave me a way to contact you.[/color]
[b][color=#1ad51d]SHIPPING[/color][/b] -Sorry no shipping, only local pick-up (or local delivery if you confirm prior arrangements with me)
[b][color=#1ad51d]LOCAL PICK-UP[/color][/b] -if you are local you can arrange for pick-up, location is just 5 minutes south of HWY 401, between Winston Churchill & Erin Mills Parkway in Mississauga
[b][color=#1ad51d]LOCAL DELIVERY[/color][/b] -local delivery options can be made between Mississauga and Toronto if you win multiple items and make prior arrangements with me.
[b][color=#1ad51d]AUCTION END[/color][/b] -the auction ending conditions will be triggered at 8 PM EST, on Thursday Dec 18, 2025 -if 8 PM on the 18th comes around and the last bid was made more than 1 hour previously, that item will immediately end -if 8 PM on the 18th comes around and the last bid was made fewer than 1 hours previously, that item will remain open until 1 hour has passed without a bid being submitted
[b][color=#1ad51d]PURCHASE AND WRAP-UP[/color][/b] -all purchased items will be sold through the BGG MarketPlace via one big manual entry to ensure that BGG receives their 3%
